title: USS Pueblo in Wonsan Harbor: aerial reconnaissance photo (CIA OXCART history, p. 308)
description: Aerial reconnaissance photograph of a coastal harbor area with dark water and rugged shoreline; small printed labels mark "USS PUEBLO" next to a vessel in the lower center and a naval base at upper right. The caption reads "USS Pueblo in Wonsan Harbor." Text below discusses the end of the OXCART program amid fiscal pressures and competition with the Air Force's SR-71 fleet.
